title: Ternary, constant relative volatilities 4 : 2 : 1, keys A and B, shortcut
purpose: (a) The shortcut (Fenske, Underwood, Gilliland) with a heavy non-key, against reference_fug.py; and Underwood's minimum reflux against the rigorous column at many stages.
method_choice: constant-alpha model system (no method to choose)

thermo.note: A model system, not a real mixture: K_i = alpha_i p(T) / P with the reference vapour pressure p(T) above (made up; it only fixes the temperatures), liquid enthalpy 0 and vapour enthalpy equal to the latent heat for every component, so the energy balances give constant molar overflow exactly. docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md does not apply: there is no real mixture to choose a method for.

behaviour: N_min, R_min, N and the feed stage as reference_fug.py (fixture: shortcut)
the heavy non-key C goes almost entirely to the bottoms (Fenske's distribution)
the rigorous column with many stages (101) needs a reflux ratio at or just above Underwood's R_min for the same recovery of A (fixture: checks.rmin_against_rigorous)
expected.branch: Underwood's root theta is the one between alpha_B = 2 and alpha_A = 4 (the keys); the other roots belong to no specification here.

engine_against_reference.why: Closed formulas and one root of a monotonic function: the shortcut and the reference must agree to rounding.

tolerances.not_a_numerical_check: Gilliland's correlation (Eduljee's form) is a fit to columns; its N is not compared with the rigorous column.
